newsitem.title: USA: Clinton declines comment on Greenspan remarks.
newsitem.headline: Clinton declines comment on Greenspan remarks.

text.p: President Clinton Wednesday declined comment on remarks by Federal Reserve Board Chairman Alan Greenspan, who voiced concern about soaring stock prices and the risk of higher inflation.

Asked for his reaction during a picture-taking session with visiting Chilean President Eduardo Frei, Clinton told reporters he would answer questions at his joint news conference with Frei later in the day.
